_comment: Avatar. Figma has the component set but no `colors/avatar` variable group — every fill and stroke it uses belongs to `colors/top-and-footer`, so the colours are authored here against the semantic layer like Tooltip's.

_verified_from.scope: all 10 variants across the three axes (Type, On bg Red, Show Edit)
_verified_from.result: Base frame 40x40. Inside it a 33.5x33.5 circle with 2.5 padding and a 1.4px INSIDE stroke, holding a 28.5x28.5 disc. Member fills that disc with an image; Guest fills it and drops a 16px `filled-user` on top; Avatar masks an illustration into it. Show Edit adds a 12x12 disc carrying an 8px `filled-Camera`.
_verified_from.scaling: The profile header instances this at 56 and every inner value scales with it: 33.5 becomes 46.9, 2.5 becomes 3.5, 1.4 becomes 1.96, 28.5 becomes 39.9 — read unrounded from both the base and the instance. Exactly 1.4x throughout, which is why the component takes a size and multiplies rather than carrying a second set of numbers.

corrections.half-pixel values: First read had the ring at 34 and the disc at 29 — those were my own rounding of the dump, not Figma's numbers. Figma says 33.5 and 28.5, and the halves are what make the 56px instance land on 46.9 and 39.9.
corrections.ring stroke ate the padding: The ring was a CSS `border`, which consumes the padding box: a 46.9 circle with 3.5 padding and a 1.96 border left a 36.7 disc instead of 39.9. Figma strokes INSIDE, which does not. Now an inset box-shadow.

_source.ring-padding / ring-border-width: 2.5 and 1.4 — fractional because they were drawn at 40 and are meant to scale. Neither is on the spacing or border-width ladder and neither should be: they are a ratio of the avatar, not a step in a scale.
_source.colours: Read off the variants. `On bg Red=Yes` puts a white ring around the avatar and a white disc under the guest glyph; `No` inverts both to brand red. Figma binds these to `colors/top-and-footer/*`, which resolve to the semantic roles referenced here.
_source.edit-background: #C9C9C9, which Figma calls `topfoot-bg-gray-light` and this system holds as text.state.light-gray. Same value, different name — the rename map covers it.

_figma_gaps.no-colour-group: There is no `colors/avatar` variable group. The component borrows `colors/top-and-footer`, which is why its colours are authored against the semantic layer rather than mirrored.
_figma_gaps.illustration-not-portable: The `Type=Avatar` variant masks an illustration that lives only in Figma. The component exposes the slot; the artwork has to be exported before it can render.

_figma_icons._comment: The icons Figma instantiates for this component, read 2026-08-20 by walking the instance tree and keeping every main component whose parent set is `icons`. check-figma-icons.py holds the files in `sources` to exactly this set — an extra icon fails as loudly as a missing one, because an extra is one nobody compared. Files not listed in `sources` carry payload a caller passes, not a choice the design makes.

icons.filled-Camera: the edit badge on Type=Member and Type=Avatar, `Frame 1000012443`, when Show Edit=Yes
icons.filled-user: the placeholder face on Type=Guest, inside `Avata`
